families.name: runtime_controls
families.required_assertions: Valid native System transfer succeeds; controls have exact signature/blockhash failure and no native-program reach claim. Sigverify/blockhash stay ON.

families.name: native_genesis_pool_0pct
families.required_assertions: Genuine native S10^19/dec7/setup+revocations/HInitialize;0% initial liquidity; exact recorded creator=beneficiary,SomeBothToken, untouched config0; mint supply versus pool.lp_supply/minimum convention distinct; R0/custody0/Reserve sentinel fixed.

families.name: LP_mint_ABI_candidates
families.required_assertions: Separate fresh VMs and standalone Lock tx with identical data/all other metas. No other instruction/alias promotes LP mint. At least one candidate must genuinely lock100% Lrecv; both failing blocks dependent cases. Exact errors/status kept; mere load/flags is not PASS.

families.name: metadata_flag
families.required_assertions: Actual selected binaries; typed Metadata executable supplied in both branches. Primary true must create genuine metadata; false behavior/authority/charges recorded without assumed skipped CPI. No invented MasterEdition/AuthRules metas.

families.name: exact_initial_receipt
families.required_assertions: Assert actual Lrecv==999999999900 before primary lock, debit/escrow credit exactlyLrecv, FeeKey supply1/dec0/currentowner and actual authorities, metadata/state provenance. No pure initial burn or wallet-total shortcut.

families.name: shared_escrow_preexisting
families.required_assertions: After initial pool receipt measurement, B genuinely depositsLP1e10 and locks5e9 first; W then locks100% initial receipt. Shared vault prebalance5e9, W deltaLrecv, both independent states/FeeKeys; B mobile5e9 preserved.

families.name: later_unrelated_liquidity
families.required_assertions: B genuine depositLP1e10 at active800bps with frozen max input bounds; lock5e9, remaining5e9 mobile; per-position burns/claims cannot debit other state/mobile position. Pool/mint supply and native deposit tax reconcile.

families.name: both_personal_streams
families.required_assertions: Genuine eight base swaps, both assets gross/net/withheld; creator and FeeKey receipts to same W with fee/setup payerP; R/custody/Reserve unchanged; not all nominal0.50% personal.

families.name: FeeKey_current_owner
families.required_assertions: Native legacy TransferChecked1/dec0 through P-funded holder accounts, actual signerB thenW; former owner loses claim right; pool creator staysW; historical locked_owner alone gives no right. Later native swaps generate repeated earned claims.

families.name: claim_authority_negatives
families.required_assertions: Must reach intended genuine locker check from valid native setup; no mere upstream init error counted. Freeze observed exact native code in focused trials before complete run. All effects rollback except actual fee-payer network fee.

families.name: NFT_zero_or_wrong_amount
families.required_assertions: Amount0 constructed by genuine authorized NFT burn; amount2 is explicitly rejection-only corruption, no positive minted entitlement. Neither counts as positive state. Exact native error and full rollback required.

families.name: LP_amount_negatives
families.required_assertions: Source amount genuinely insufficient, no fake credit; classify only exact intended native insufficient/amount error, not setup failure.

families.name: lock_relationship_negatives
families.required_assertions: Only one supplied relationship changed after valid base state. Genuine wrong program account used, no fake executable handler. Exact error, zero committed new FeeKey/state/metadata accounts.

families.name: claim_relationship_negatives
families.required_assertions: Reach intended native call; wrong Memo is a different genuine program account, never silent default Memo substitution. Exact classified code and rollback.

families.name: privilege_negatives
families.required_assertions: Inspect compiled-message flags. For absent P signer use distinct real transaction fee payer so automatic fee-payer signature cannot mask the negative. ABI lpMint-readonly remainsL03, not assumed invalid here.

families.name: alias_negatives
families.required_assertions: Keep documented permitted role coalescing/program duplicates; these are unsupported cross-asset/state aliases with valid setup and intended-check reach evidence.

families.name: finite_positive_swap_invariants
families.required_assertions: Fresh valid balances/available liquidity, no filtering/skips; genuine CPMM must execute. Independent immutable quote oracle/fresh raw deltas for both input-fee rates2500, native800, liabilities, effective reserves, supply; not copied locker growth logic.

families.name: dust_swap_boundaries
families.required_assertions: Pure reference predicts possible positive result or native zero-output failure; actual native outcome and exact errors classified in focused source-frozen trials. Unexpected errors fail; only expected native dust rollback or verified real positive conservation is case completion.

families.name: empty_and_repeated_claim
families.required_assertions: No fabricated earned entitlement. Native no-op/error behavior unknown; no-op must not pay/burn principal, error exact and rollback. State bookkeeping/time changes inspected; never count empty success as positive income.

families.name: finite_fee_LP_requests
families.required_assertions: Each uses genuine earned baseline, amounts are fee-LP not HTFP. Actual gross/net/LP burn/counters/limits/principal floor reconcile. Tiny native output may fail; focused exact classification before final run, no broad error acceptance.

families.name: claim_recipient_authority
families.required_assertions: HolderW signs. Measure native destination authorization honestly; public interface is mint-only. If allowed, record holder-directed route as a limitation, not same-wallet enforcement or an unauthorized-user bypass. Primary L08 always pins W recipients.

families.name: late_System_failure_after_lock
families.required_assertions: Otherwise valid complete native Lock then real System transferP->W u64MAX failsCustom1; actual locker success/inner effects reached, all newly tracked absent-before accounts return absent, metadata rent/create fees revert, only network fee remains.

families.name: late_System_failure_after_claim
families.required_assertions: Accrued real fees and otherwise successful claim before later real SystemCustom1. All state/LP burn/recipient tax/payer program charges revert, except actual transaction fee. No debug endpoint or fake callback.

families.name: late_compute_cuts
families.required_assertions: Fresh successful calibrationCU for each op; limit=max(5000,total_calibrationCU-margin), <=1.4M. Require exact exhausted-budget native class and matching meter evidence, actual phase reached, raw rollback. If selected cut misses intended phase, retain limited coverage; no invented intermediate state.

families.name: replay_and_later_native_activity
families.required_assertions: Initialized FeeKey/state replay must not reset/reissue/unlock; later real trades/earned claims succeed with chosen valid ABI. Exact native errors for replay; supply and both-position principal accounting remain.

families.name: native_SOL_fee_unwrap
families.required_assertions: No trading bankroll or rent counted as fees. Native CloseAccount->P plus P->W exact actual fee amount, P keeps only storage deposit, Reserve unchanged. Late genuine SystemCustom1 rolls all close/transfer effects back except actual network fee.

full_acceptance: Every required positive reaches genuine selected native program and satisfies raw invariants. ABI/boundary diagnostics classified separately, never make missing positive pass. Any unclassified error, zero discovered cases, missing raw evidence, input/artifact change or exceeded budget fails.
unknown_error_codes: Locker handler bodies are unavailable. Do not invent numeric codes or accept arbitrary failures. Focused immutable-source trials establish exact intended native codes/reached checks before final complete run; classify dependency/setup/resource failures as blockers, not expected negatives. Retain all trials and source associations.
case_instance_policy: Each privilege probe/metadata/dust/amount case uses fresh deterministic setup; failed negatives may share an unchanged valid prestate only with full rollback proof and decreasing payer fee balance. New account identities tracked even when absent.
static_program_bytes: One full artifact plus per-tx immutable SHA references; no repeated ELF payload snapshots
property_guidance: property-based-testing SKILL.md + generating.md: finite valid domain construction without assume/filter; pinned boundaries, independent quote oracle and conservation/ownership/rollback properties; no exhaustive-domain or shrinking claim.
